summary: Iteration 9 (Pages CMS + extended ExtraField types + member-scope extras) — 13 new pytest tests added, all passing. Pages CMS verified end-to-end (backend + frontend). Custom fields with new types (email/number/checkbox/radio/file) and member-scope extras validated via POST /api/registrations. Brevo sender fix confirmed via DIAG deliveries. Total test suite now 63 tests (50 prior + 13 new), 100% pass.

minor.issue: email_service logs 'Email sent to ...' on Brevo HTTP 201 regardless of whether Brevo later rejects delivery (sender invalid). Consider polling/logging the Brevo event status or at minimum documenting that INFO 'Email sent' means accepted by Brevo for relay, not delivered to inbox.

action_items: (Minor) Consider surfacing real Brevo delivery failures — right now email_service.send_email only checks HTTP 201 from Brevo transactional API. Historical 'sender not valid' rejections only appear in the Brevo events dashboard, not in backend logs.

(Enhancement) The Pages tab list row doesn't expose a `page-delete-{id}` testid — only the editor does. If testing/scripted deletion of a page from the list view is important, add `data-testid="page-delete-{id}"` on the row's delete button.
critical_code_review_comments: Pages CMS: `/api/pages/{slug}` GET is PUBLIC (no auth + no published filter). An admin could technically write an unpublished draft page and its content is still accessible via direct slug URL. Consider filtering `published: True` in the public `/api/pages/{slug}` endpoint and keeping admin access through `/api/admin/pages/{id}` only.

PUT /api/pages/{id} does not verify the page exists BEFORE calling update_one — if page_id is bogus, the $set is a no-op but then find_one returns None and raises 404. This is fine but a pre-check would avoid a dead DB write.
validate_mode_payload: when an extra field is scope='member' on an individual-mode event, the scope is ignored (falls through to team-extras). Fine per spec but worth documenting.
build_email_rows: for member-scope extras with no answers, emits '-'. Consider omitting the row entirely when there are zero answers for a cleaner admin email.
Page model: `slug` is not validated against a regex (only trimmed + spaces->hyphen). Admin could create slug 'foo/bar' or 'foo?baz' which would break routing. Add a simple `^[a-z0-9-]+$` validator.
seed_data_creation: All test pages/events prefixed TEST_/ui-test- and cleaned up in finally blocks. Context-mentioned 'scale-plus' seed page was not present at start of testing (admin showed 0 pages).
